units.name: Archer
units.description: Swift sentinel striking from the shadows of the forest.
units.lore: She learned the bow before she learned to speak, and the forest taught her both. The arrow is loosed before the leaf lands.

units.name: Wisp
units.description: Grove spirit that darts past slow towers and dies to one hit.
units.lore: A spirit of the grove, more light than body. It drifts where the forest wants to look and ends where it must.

units.name: Huntress
units.description: Mounted glaive rider that crosses the map before towers reload.
units.lore: Glaive and nightsaber move as one shadow under the moon. What she hunts does not hear the branches part.

units.name: Dryad
units.description: Half-spirit creature that slips through unarmored and quick.
units.lore: Daughter of the grove, half bark and half breeze. Spells slide off her like rain off a leaf.

units.name: Chimera
units.description: Twin-headed beast too heavy to keep up with its own kin.
units.lore: Two heads grown from one old grudge of the wild. It is too heavy for the canopy, so it comes the long way, and it still comes.

units.name: Druid of the Claw
units.description: Bear-shaped druid, the broadest thing the forest sends on foot.
units.lore: He slept a thousand years as a bear and woke as one. The claw remembers what the druid chose to forget.

units.name: Hippogryph
units.description: Crag flyer that crosses the board before towers turn.
units.lore: Half eagle, half stag, wholly of the high crags. It stoops like a thought and is gone before the string sings.

units.name: Mountain Giant
units.description: Walking crag with trees on its back and no reason to hurry.
units.lore: The mountain grew tired of being climbed and stood up. Trees ride on its shoulders, and it does not hurry for anyone.
